programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est à nouveau l'heure de la compétition de danse de Fraisi-Paradis ! Prunetille est stressée et exténuée : elle veut absolument gagner ! Mais ses adversaires sont redoutables. Elles sont élégantes et synchronisées à merveille....

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les filles sont toutes réunies au café. Charlotte essaie de faire de la compote de pommes maison à l'aide d'un maillet (et fait en fait plein de cochonneries), tandis que les autres sont occupées à fabriquer leurs propres papiers cadeaux et...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Lili Framboise est bouleversée. Elle soupçonne ses amies d'avoir copié la lanterne qu'elle a créée pour le Bal de la fraise scintillante. Et puis, elle découvre la véritable signification du festival.

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.sub-title: Le bal de la Fraise scintillante
programme.desc: Réunies à siroter un jus de pomme chaud au café de Charlotte, les filles sont impatientes de voir l'hiver arriver. Elles énumèrent les différentes traditions qu'elles aiment à propos de la saison, mais la seule sur laquelle elles sont...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Mimi Citron est aux anges. Elle se précipite chez toutes les autres filles en leur annonçant : " Ça y est ! " et les invitant à la rejoindre. Elles la suivent au salon et sont complètement éblouies par sa nouvelle création : les...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle travaille dans son magasin, Fleur d'oranger entend les Petits-Pépins rire et crier à l'extérieur. Lorsqu'elle s'approche de la porte pour enquêter, une touffe de pissenlit se faufile à l'intérieur, poursuivie par trois...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Au café, le petit déjeuner des filles est interrompu par de la musique provenant du pavillon. Elles sortent pour voir ce qu'il se passe et découvrent Annabelle et Isabelle portant des badges à côté d'une bannière et d'un podium, des chaises...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Avec tellement de Petits-Pépins à Fraisi-Paradis, la princesse Fraisinette décide de construire une garderie et une aire de jeu. Mais elle s'inquiète : tout ce métal gris et bois marron, c'est vraiment terne. Elle demande à Charlotte qui...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: De retour au café après une promenade avec ses animaux, Charlotte est accueillie par M. Millepattes. Il l'attend pour qu'ils puissent commencer à préparer toutes les bonnes choses et les décorations pour la fête d'Annabelle et d'Isabelle cet...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Petit Pépin l'Ancien réussit à faire pousser des fruits et légumes de petite taille. Il demande à Fleur d'Oranger d'écouler sa production. Mais sa boutique ne peut pas accueillir autant de denrées. Fleur d'Oranger redouble d'ingéniosité...

programme.title: Hwayi: A Monster Boy
programme.desc: Hwayi est un garçon qui vit dans un village agricole. Il a été élevé par cinq pères, tous des criminels notoires. Un jour, le groupe reçoit l'ordre d'assassiner un homme nommé Lim et sa femme.

programme.title: Alliés
programme.desc: Août 1944. Une équipe de soldats Britanniques dirigée par un Capitaine Américain est envoyée en France derrière les lignes ennemies pour une mission qui pourrait mettre fin à la guerre. Mais rien ne se passe comme prévu. Le Sergent Harry McBrain et le Capitaine Gabriel Jackson comprennent qu'ils doivent mettre de côtés leur rivalité personnelle pour mener à bien leur mission.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Un prince et son serviteur apprennent qu'une magnifique princesse est plongée dans un sommeil éternel suite à une malédiction. Ils se lancent dans un dangereux périple et doivent affronter une reine maléfique et une armée de morts-vivants pour la délivrer.

programme.title: Fugitive Mind
programme.desc: Un homme découvre qu'on lui a fait subir un lavage de cerveau pour qu'il tue un important représentant du gouvernement.

programme.title: Deux Cupidons Pour Noël
programme.desc: Holly enseigne la littérature et cherche le grand amour. Elle rencontre Josh, un bel avocat, qui peine à la séduire. Josh engage son ami David, lui aussi professeur de littérature, pour écrire des poèmes à Holly à sa place.

programme.title: Un Noël Inattendu
programme.desc: Vicki et Jason, un couple séparé, sont invités par leurs enfants à passer ensemble les vacances de Noël à la plage. La situation se complique lorsque le patron de Vicki et l'assistante de Jason débarquent.

programme.title: Un nouveau départ pour Noël
programme.desc: Laissant de côté sa vie glamour à Hollywood, Evie Lee retourne dans sa petite ville natale, dans la ferme de sapins de Noël autrefois prospère de sa famille pour assister aux funérailles de son père. Elle doit à présent reprendre la gestion de la ferme, au grand désarroi de son frère cadet.

programme.title: La Voleuse De Noël
programme.desc: Peu avant Noël, Kate Dove et son complice sont filmés en plein braquage. Malheureusement, Kate avait enlevé sa cagoule au moment d'ouvrir le coffre-fort, et tous les journaux télévisés se sont aussitôt mis à passer sa photo en boucle.

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent, tueur à gages à la retraite, profite d'un hiver paisible avec sa femme et leur fils sur le point de partir à l'université. Leur calme est brisé par l'arrivée surprise de son ex-femme, de leur fils adulte et de sa compagne enceinte, tous en fuite. Traqués par d'anciens associés de Vincent, ils réveillent un passé dangereux, et les retrouvailles prennent rapidement une tournure inattendue.

programme.title: Dixieland
programme.desc: Un jeune homme récemment sorti de prison, malchanceux et imprévisible, et une jeune fille séduisante et issue d'une famille déséquilibrée, se retrouvent entraînés dans une spirale criminelle alors qu'ils essaient de fuir leur petite ville sans avenir à la recherche d'une vie meilleure.

programme.title: Italian Race
programme.desc: Giulia est une championne de course en puissance qui voit sa vie basculer lorsque son père décède. Mineure, elle ne peut compter que sur son frère qu'elle n'a pas vu depuis dix ans et qui est toxicomane. Ensemble, ils vont essayer de remonter la pente grâce à leur passion commune : la course automobile.

programme.title: Drive or Die
programme.desc: Michael, un jeune voleur de voitures, est recruté par la police pour infiltrer un gang de trafiquants de véhicules de luxe, mené par les cruels Charlie et Sammy. Jusqu'où pourra-t-il mener ce double jeu dangereux ?

programme.title: La semaine des 4 jeudis
programme.desc: Marc a rencontré une fille qui lui a tapé dans l'oeil. Leur histoire va être d'autant plus compliquée que la semaine des quatre jeudis commence aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Fugazi
programme.desc: 2039 : depuis plus de 3 ans, Adèle travaille pour Orbit Defence, une station spatiale chargée du pilotage de drones sur la planète Terre. Aujourd'hui, tenant entre ses mains des joysticks, il ne lui reste plus qu'une mission de routine à accomplir avant de rejoindre enfin sa famille.

programme.title: A l'ombre du voile
programme.desc: Deux femmes musulmanes, une mère et sa fille, se rendent à une manifestation contre l'interdiction du voile à l'école. De retour à la maison, la mère invite sa fille à abandonner ce voile à travers une danse désespérée et troublante.

programme.title: Le pont
programme.desc: Un homme et son fils vivent au sommet d'un pic escarpé, totalement coupés du monde extérieur : le père a veillé à tenir son fils éloigné des réalités de l'humanité. Mais une nuit, l'enfant aperçoit, en bas de la falaise, une ville dont les lumières brillent.

programme.title: Paix sur la terre
programme.desc: La nuit tombe quelque part sur la terre. Ca et là, des ovoïdes traversent le ciel et s'abattent sur le sol. Peu après, on retrouve des sièges vides et des cannes à pêche plantées dans l'herbe... Tout devient extrêmement calme.

programme.title: Fugue
programme.desc: Un petit bonhomme tout à fait quelconque veut prendre soin d'une jeune pousse en la mettant au soleil. Dans un filet, il capture un nuage pour pouvoir abreuver la plante, mais celui-ci, se transformant en eau, glisse au travers des mailles. Le petit bonhomme tentera par tous les moyens de rattraper ce filet d'eau indispensable au bien-être de sa plante.

programme.title: Les yeux de la tête
programme.desc: John, un grand acteur américain, alors qu'il joue amicalement un trou au golf en France, reçoit une balle en pleine figure et perd un oeil. Il peut cependant compter sur l'excellence de la médecine européenne et l'émergence de l'économie chinoise...

programme.title: Le printemps de Bernard
programme.desc: Bernard travaille à la patinoire municipale depuis toujours, mais il s'ennuie de plus en plus, il a froid. Un soir, en rentrant chez lui, il surprend une sculpture d'athlète en bronze en train de sortir de la douche. Au tour d'un plat de nouilles propices à toutes les confidences, ils se découvrent un rêve en commun : partir à la mer.

programme.title: C'est fini avec Loïc
programme.desc: Mélanie est une comédienne heureuse. Elle doit rencontrer aujourd'hui le réalisateur qu'elle admire le plus au monde. Mais le comportement de ce dernier va transformer le (son?) rêve en cauchemar...

programme.title: La nouvelle musique
programme.desc: Dans un univers semblable au nôtre, il n'existe qu'un seule musique. Appelé “la musique”, cette suite d'accords berce l'humanité depuis des siècles. Pour Tom, bientôt au chômage, cette suite est devenue insupportable.

programme.title: À cheval dans une maison vide
programme.desc: Au cours d'un voyage d'une journée, un adulte et un adolescent vont voir leur vie durablement modifiée. L'un est un éducateur spécialisé, l'autre est un adolescent sortant juste de prison.

programme.title: Chronique panoramique
programme.desc: Tous ces gens silencieux dans le train, qui sont-ils vraiment et à quoi peuvent-ils bien réfléchir en ce moment même ?

programme.title: Marche forcée
programme.desc: A l'occasion d'une classe verte dans les Cévennes, Lucas, professeur de français dans un lycée de banlieue, surprend deux de ses élèves, Samia et Djome, à l'écart en train de fumer de l'herbe mais bientôt le trio se perd dans le paysage de rivières et de forêts sauvages...

Après un séisme, un homme se réveille emprisonné dans les décombres. Lorsque tout espoir semble perdu, il découvre qu'il n'est pas seul, une autre personne est prisonnière. Ensemble, ils vont tenter de survivre à cette situation désespérée.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Ena, femme pompière passionnée, est très investie dans son métier. Sa fascination pour le feu l'épanouie autant qu'elle impacte sur sa vie familiale.

programme.title: Mémo
programme.desc: Louis, retraité, veut à tout prix garder son indépendance face à la surprotection de sa fille Nina.

programme.title: J'aime beaucoup ta mère
programme.desc: Stéphane, quarante ans, une ancienne petite terreur du collège rend visite à sa mère. Celle-ci doit lui présenter son nouveau compagnon : Martin Mollard, sa tête de turc du collège….

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: Ni vu ni connu
programme.desc: Embauché par une femme qui se pense trompée, pour kidnapper et corriger la maîtresse de son mari, un escroc à la petite semaine met au point avec une de ses connaissances une combine pour empocher facilement l'argent. Mais le jour de la confrontation, les choses prennent un tour inattendu.

programme.title: Il faut qu'on parle
programme.desc: Nous avons tous quitté un jour, un(e) conjoint(e) sans raisons valables, si ce n'est l'envie de passer à autre chose. Et bien c'est ce que va faire le personnage d'Adam. Mais l'annonce de sa décision ne va pas se passer comme prévue…

programme.title: Où elle est maman ?
programme.desc: Roberto, Pablo et Sacha sont trois frères. Il y a quelques jours ils viennent de perdre leur maman. Leur papa, Joseph, semble ne pas se préoccuper de la situation. Pour lui, son épouse est encore là. C'est dans cet étrange contexte que les trois hommes vont devoir accompagner leur père dans cet instant difficile, de la marche funèbre à cette nuit où il va disparaître.

programme.title: Underwater
programme.desc: Jeanne Clairsen, "Oreille d'Or" dans la marine, est appelée par le Commissaire Delattre, afin qu'elle perce tous les bruits qui apporteraient la preuve qu'une nouvelle victime est bien détenue chez le suspect qu'ils ont mis sur écoute.

programme.title: Yùl et le serpent
programme.desc: Yùl, treize ans, accompagne son grand frère Dino pour conclure un deal avec Mike, petite frappe accompagnée de son dogue argentin. Alors que la situation tourne mal, un étrange serpent apparaît.

programme.title: À demi mot
programme.desc: Quand Laurène et Sacha se réveillent dans les bras l'un de l'autre, leur amour semble être une évidence, jusqu'à ce que les mots viennent s'immiscer dans leur histoire.

programme.title: How To Murder A Millionaire
programme.desc: Une femme riche est convaincue que son mari a l'intention de l'assassiner, ce qui donne lieu à une comédie d'erreurs de plus en plus trépidante.

programme.title: The Cobbler
programme.desc: Max Simkin est un cordonnier solitaire, légèrement malheureux, qui découvre une machine magique lui permettant, s'il chausse les chaussures de ses clients, de leur ressembler trait pour trait.

programme.title: Ratchet Et Clank
programme.desc: Ratchet et Clank unissent leur force, intelligence et courage pour lutter contre le maléfique Drek qui veut détruire la galaxie. Avec l'aide des Rangers Galactiques ils vont se lancer dans une aventure spectaculaire ! Ce duo de choc est basé sur la franchise des jeux vidéo Ratchet & Clank de Sony, qui a été écoulée à plus de 13 millions d'exemplaires à travers le monde.

programme.title: The Women
programme.desc: Mary est mariée à Stephen Haines, un homme d'affaires new-yorkais. Fidèle à son époux et mère d'une fillette, elle est entourée d'"amies", dont Sylvia Fowler, la comtesse DeLave, et Miriam Aarons, qui savent quelque chose qu'elle ignore : son mari la trompe avec Crystal Allen, une vendeuse arriviste...

programme.title: Paranoïa (2018)
programme.desc: Une jeune femme, convaincue d'être harcelée, est enfermée contre son gré dans une institution psychiatrique. Alors même qu'elle tente de convaincre tout le monde qu'elle est en danger, elle commence à se demander si sa peur est fondée ou le fruit de son imagination.

programme.title: Amityville
programme.desc: Dans cette terrifiante histoire vraie, George (Ryan Renolds), Kathy Lutz (Melissa George) et leurs enfants emménagent à Amityville, New York, dans une maison où s'est déroulé un terrible meurtre de masse… S'en suivent 28 jours d'horreur.

programme.title: Usurpation
programme.desc: Katie déménage en ville avec sa jeune fille pour démarrer une nouvelle vie. Elle devient rapidement amie avec un autre couple qui commence à se poser des questions après avoir observé son étrange comportement.

programme.title: Mi-Temps Au Mitard
programme.desc: La star légendaire du Football Américain Paul Crewe se retrouve en prison et y retrouve l'ancien entraîneur Nate Scarboro. La direction de la prison organise chaque année un tournoi entre les surveillants et les prisonniers.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Des personnes aux capacités surhumaines se dressent face à un gouvernement qui veut exploiter et abuser de leurs pouvoirs. Chris Evans et Dakota Fanning font équipe dans ce thriller paranormal palpitant.

programme.title: Turbo Interceptor
programme.desc: Jake est assassiné par des voyous de quartier. Il revient sous une forme surnaturelle (Le Spectre) pour se venger.

programme.title: Le royaume interdit
programme.desc: Un adolescent américain obsédé par le kung-fu l'envoie à l'aventure en Chine, où il rejoint une bande de guerriers d'arts martiaux afin de libérer le Roi Singe.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Des personnes aux capacités surhumaines se dressent face à un gouvernement qui veut exploiter et abuser de leurs pouvoirs. Chris Evans et Dakota Fanning font équipe dans ce thriller paranormal palpitant.

programme.title: John and the Hole
programme.desc: John ressemble à tous les collégiens de son âge. En famille aussi, il se sent bien… Un jour, il découvre au fond de son jardin un vieux bunker. Contre toute attente, il décide d'y enfermer sa sœur et ses parents après les avoir sédatés.

programme.title: Jeff, Who Lives at Home
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il se fait expulser de chez sa mère, Jeff pense pouvoir enfin découvrir son destin en passant la journée avec son frère à la recherche de sa femme qui semble être infidèle.

programme.title: Inappropriate Comedy
programme.desc: Un film à sketches politiquement (très) incorrect.

programme.title: Freedom Writers
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire de gamins durs à cuire élevés dans des milieux difficiles et la violence. Hilary Swank incarne une prof qui va leur donner la chose dont ils ont le plus besoin : une voix pour s'exprimer.

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: Dans cette adaptation du classique de 83, Julie (Jessica Rothe) incarne parfaitement la petite fille parfaite qui voit son univers bouleversé lorsqu'elle tombe amoureuse de Randy (Josh Whitehouse), un punk rocker d'Hollywood !

programme.title: About Fate
programme.desc: Alors que leurs demandes en mariage respectives échouent, Margot (Emma Roberts) et Griffin (Thomas Mann), deux grands romantiques, se retrouvent ensemble le soir du Nouvel An après une série d'événements fortuits.

programme.title: Dirty 30
programme.desc: C'est un peu l'impasse dans la vie des amies de toujours Kate (Mamrie Hart), Evie (Grace Helbig) et Charlie (Hannah Hart). A la veille de son trentième anniversaire, Kate accepte de laisser Evie et Charlie lui organiser une fête.

programme.title: Tous les chemins mènent à Rome
programme.desc: Une mère de famille un peu à cran, se voit partir en road trip en Italie avec son amour de jeunesse Italien, afin de rattraper sa fille rebelle, qui souhaite rejoindre New-York à tout prix.

programme.title: Maltese
programme.sub-title: Le Roman du Commissaire - Maltese - Episode 6
programme.desc: En Sicile, dans les années 70, le chef de la police, Maltese, se retrouve mêlé à une enquête qui mettra à jour l'influence généralisée de la mafia dans la région et dévoilera les racines archaïques qui l'ont nourrie.

programme.title: Désobeir
programme.desc: Juin 1940. Alors que les troupes allemandes envahissent la France, Aristides de Souza Mendes, consul du Portugal à Bordeaux, entreprend la plus grande action de sauvetage menée par une seule personne pendant l'holocauste. Bravant sa hierarchie ainsi que les ordres du dictateur Salazar, il permet à des milliers de réfugiés de rejoindre son pays natal, au péril de sa vie.

programme.title: Flirt et Passe-Passe
programme.desc: Des jumelles identiques, Alice et Lacey, sont prises l'une pour l'autre lors d'une retraite. Elles décident de jouer le jeu le temps du séjour, mais réalisent bientôt qu'elles se sont peut-être trompées sur ce dont elles avaient réellement besoin dans leur vie.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: L'histoire d'un livre perdu depuis longtemps qui réapparaît mystérieusement et relie un vieil homme à la recherche de son fils à une jeune fille cherchant un remède à la solitude de sa mère.

programme.title: Accélération
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, un seigneur du crime vicieux, est doublé par son agent le plus fiable, Rhona.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Un puissant guerrier chinois tourne au crime après le meurtre de ses parents et l'enlèvement de sa sœur.

programme.title: Secteur 4
programme.desc: Les membres d'un commando d'élite sont envoyés en mission au coeur d'un camp islamiste : le secteur 4.

programme.title: Fire Girls
programme.desc: Un tueur à gages célèbre de L.A. tombe amoureux de sa cible.

programme.title: Accélération
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, un seigneur du crime vicieux, est doublé par son agent le plus fiable, Rhona.

programme.title: Noël avec un inconnu
programme.desc: Adapté du best-seller. Darcy Archer est une romantique qui rêve d'être séduite par l'homme idéal. Un jour, alors qu'elle se rend au travail à vélo, Darcy percute accidentellement un bel inconnu élégant promenant son chien. Ce dernier perd connaissance et est transporté à l'hôpital, laissant derrière lui son chiot et un mystérieux cadeau de Noël. Tandis que Darcy aide Aidan à surmonter son amnésie, ils découvrent ensemble qui il est vraiment. Un baiser scellera-t-il la nuit de Noël ?

programme.title: Monsieur Noël et moi
programme.desc: Zoé convainc Sam, libraire discret, de participer au concours « Monsieur Noël » afin de promouvoir son agence. Mais au fil des épreuves festives, leur relation devient bien plus personnelle.

programme.title: Coup de foudre en livraison
programme.desc: Une animatrice de télévision réalise un reportage sur une fleuriste innovante et son célèbre concours floral. Cette rencontre pourrait bien lui ouvrir les portes d'une nouvelle carrière… et de l'amour.

programme.title: Le gala de l'amour

programme.title: Potins De Femmes

La mariée s'appelle Shelby (Julia Roberts), une belle jeune femme têtue dont la mère très stricte, M'Lynn (Sally Field), est prête à tout pour elle. Dolly Parton à la chevelure imposante joue le rôle de Truvy, la propriétaire d'un salon de beauté qui est le centre non officiel de la ville. Parmi sa clientèle jamais en reste de potins, il y a Ouiser (Shirley MacLaine), la femme la plus riche et la plus méchante du coin, et Clairee (Olympia Dukakis), une élégante veuve plutôt sournoise. L'atmosphère s'anime avec l'arrivée d'une nouvelle jeune femme, Annelle (Daryl Hannah), une stagiaire un peu naïve avec ses lunettes de chat et son passé mystérieux. Ces six « magnolias de fer » forment un groupe de soutien et d'amitié et constituent un bon auditoire pour les blagues des unes et des autres malgré les aléas de l'existence et de l'amour dans une petite ville du sud.

programme.title: Hearts Bride
programme.desc: When David Tutera meets Heather Homan and Josh Tomes of Ontario, California, he finds a couple with a terrific theme for their wedding, but horrible execution. They want their wedding to be a celebration of love: hearts and the color pink everywhere but have wound up with a tacky disaster. From the zebra ties to the pink centerpieces to the glow sticks they plan to give to their guests this couple really needs David's expertise! Just when David thought it couldn't get any worse, the couple tells him that, with only three weeks before the wedding, they don't even have a venue yet! David uses the next three weeks sprucing up Heather's bland bridesmaid dresses, putting her into a fantastic party dress, and most importantly, finding the couple the right venue. The surprises don't stop there, as David takes the entire bridal party on a hair-raising day of fun!

programme.title: Monopoly Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera faces one of the toughest challenges of his career when he meets Tasha and Evan of Los Angeles, California and finds out their theme: the board game “Monopoly”! With menus and centerpieces designed to resemble game cards, and a plan to have their guests pay for their food with fake money, David wonders if they've been planning a wedding or a child's birthday party! Things get worse when David finds out that neither Tasha nor her brides like their dresses, which are far too revealing, and to top it off, they're planning on having the ceremony and reception in a friend's back yard! David had just three weeks to keep this couple's dreams from going directly to jail!

programme.title: Belly Dancing Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera's weddings work best when his couples incorporate something from their own life into their wedding as their theme, but when he meets Shirley and Andy from Los Angeles, California, he finds a theme that poses a huge challenge: belly dancing. Shirley absolutely loves her hobby but may have gone a little overboard in her planning: she plans to put herself and her brides in noisy shimmy belts, has peacock feather centerpieces, and to top it all off, she's had a fake foam cake made to save money! Shirley's bridesmaid dresses are a mismatched mess that don't fit their body types, and when David sees Shirley's dress, he's floored by how big and dramatic it is, not at all matching Shirley's personality or her theme. David's biggest challenge might be yet to come, however, because Shirley's venue for the wedding is a small Indian restaurant! In three weeks, David has to take this mismatched mess of a wedding and turn it into the ultimate sexy, exotic celebration of the art of belly dancing.

programme.title: Royal Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera is used to his brides wanting to feel like royalty on their wedding day, but when he meets Tracey from Sherman Oaks, California, he finds a bride who's take that idea even further! Tracey wants the have the ultimate royal wedding, complete with crowns and miniature castles, but when she shows David some of her wedding materials, he sees the making of a royal disaster. The items Tracey has put together are mismatched, and don't speak to the regal, opulent feel that Tracey's is looking for, and neither her gown nor her bridesmaids dresses are appropriate for a royal wedding. David has only three weeks to change every aspect of Tracey's wedding to give her the royal wedding she's always wanted.

programme.title: Make-A-Wish Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera approaches every wedding with an open heart and an open mind. But few stories have touched David as much as bride Wendy and groom Rocky's. This couple put their wedding plans on hold when Wendy's teenage son, Ryan, received a life-threatening diagnosis of cancer. Thankfully, Ryan's cancer is now in remission, and this generous young man wants to pay his good fortune forward. Ryan asked the Make-A-Wish Foundation to bring David Tutera to Topeka, Kansas, to give his mom the wedding she's been waiting for. But Wendy's dress is a disaster, and so are the rest of the wedding details. Now David has six days to create a wedding like nothing Topeka has ever seen before!

This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Mountains
programme.desc: Mountains define some of our most spectacular landscapes, creating a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. Mountains are found on every continent on Earth, covering 22% of the planet's surface. They're a vital part of our ecosystem a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds. It's no wonder that so many cultures consider mountains sacred places: gateways to the heavens.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Stewart Island, New Zealand's third largest and southernmost island, is a place of dramatic beauty and unpredictability. Here, the Pot-bellied Seahorse father has extra responsibilities, the Octopus is both hunter and hunted, and 82 Great White Sharks need to eat, too. Standing at just 30cm and weighing only 1 kg, the Little Blue Penguin is nonetheless a swift swimmer and a determined parent.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

programme.title: Wild Gangs
programme.desc: Life can be tough at times, but it gets much easier when you have friends to watch your back. Animals from across the natural world band together for all sorts of reasons. Whether it's to protect the home and family, to find food, win a mate or even go to war, it's always handy to have someone you can trust in your corner. From the classic pack of wolves stalking prey in tandem to the bullish lionfish mobs terrorising all other fish on the reef – when animals form gangs things soon get wild!

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: It's a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase plateau are dramatic scenes of wonder formed from rock. The Pajute Indians once described Bryce Canyon as: “red rocks standing like men in a basin”.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
programme.desc: Sally and Nick are off to the Twisty-Misty Mountains to meet Gordon the Gorilla. Cat knows some lizard friends who are oh-so like dragons. They can show Nick and Sally how to pretend to be dragons.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Joseph and Mary
programme.desc: During a time of much civil unrest, a holy man, Rabbi Elijah, swears an oath to protect the two young sons of a persecuted man. But while Jesus survives King Herod's slaughter of the innocents, it tragically claims the lives of the boys Elijah swore to protect.Seeking to avenge their deaths, he begins his quest for retribution. But when he meets Joseph, Mary and their young son Jesus, the anger that fuels his revenge is questioned. Elijah is faced with a life-changing choice: should he kill, or should he choose forgiveness, and in doing so, contradict every scripture upheld by his forefathers? With a powerful performance from Kevin Sorbo (Hercules, God's Not Dead), Joseph and Mary, is a stirring story of inspiration and hope, and of mercy versus revenge, set in the years before Jesus became the man who ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

But when the joke turns in to a one-night stand things become a whole lot more complicated.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan meets Gayatri and apologizes to her. He tells Gayatri that she forgave him every time and now it is his turn to return the favor. Indravadhan blindfolds Gayatri and takes her out to the garden. A treacherous Avdesh happens to see Indravadhan and Gayatri romancing and out of jealousy he burns the garden. This leaves Indravadhan and Gayatri stranded in the center of a ring of fire. Will Indravadhan learn that Avdesh has a trick up his sleeve? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Kuwar Singh tells Avdesh SIngh that he is willing to build a friendship with him. A cunning Avedesh spots Indravadhan and Gayatri watching him. Avdesh insults Kuwar SIngh and asks him to leave. Avdesh is able to fool Indravadhan and Gayatri, who think that Avdesh is intrested in an alliance. Later, Gayatri and Swarnlekha have conversation where the former asks the latter about her husband taking care of her. Will Swarnlekha confess her feelings for Laakhan. Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Avdesh decide to play a game of chess. At first, Indravadhan claims that he would not gamble. He is then convinced by Avdesh, who claims that this game would not involve any kind of gambling. The game begins and the two contenders start betting one different things. Avdesh wins the first move and asks Raj Mata to prepare food for him for a week. Indravadhan wins the next move and asks Avdesh's horse as reward. What will Avdesh bet on? Is he playing a mind game with Indravadhan? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: The game of 'shatranj' gets serious and the casual game turns into a big gamble. Indravadhan and Avdesh increases the stakes. Indravadhan tells Avdesh that he can bet anything but would never bet his wife. The game continues and in Indravadhan's absence, Kuwar singh tells Avdesh that he would give him a magnetic dice which would manipulate the numbers that he wishes. Indravadhan bets on Ameerkot and both the contenders roll their dice. Will Indravadhan finally lose Ameerkot? Keep watching the captivating episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan feels guilty losing Ameerkot to Avdesh Singh in gambling. Indravadhan cries for the mistake he had committed. When Gayatri tries to console Indravadhan, he apologizes to her. Later, Gayatri receives a note and she learns that someone has a solution for Indravadhan's problem. The note asks Gayatri to meet the person in the evening. To Gayatri's surprise, the person is none other than Avdesh himself. What will Avdesh say to Gayatri? How would he solve Indravadhan's problems? Keep watching the enrapturing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Avdesh tells Indravadhan that Gayatri had come to meet him in order to find the solution for Indravadhan' s problems. Gayatri tells Indravadhan that Avdesh is lying to him. Indravadhan asks Avdesh to continue talking. Avdesh tells Indravadhan that he had promised Gayatri to return everything back to Indravadhan, if she accepts to become his queen. What will Indravadhan' s reaction be after hearing this statement from Avdesh? Keep watching the engrossing episode of ' Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj Mata confronts Sartaj and tells him that he would be getting his money shortly. Sartaj blackmails Raj Mata claiming to leak some secrets about her. Raj mata tells Sartaj that Indravadhan would never believe him. This infuriates Raj Mata, who insults Sartaj and tells him as to how low he can stoop. Raj Mata's words angers Sartaj, who slaps Raj Mata. Avdesh too reaches the scene and watches Raj Mata get assaulted by Sartaj. Will Avdesh use this scene to his advantage? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Avdesh blackmails Raj Mata as he threatens her to reveal her secret before Indravadhan. Raj Mata tells Avdesh that he has no powers to do so. She asks Avdesh to leave Raj Mahal the very next morning. Avdesh further threatens Raj Mata when he says that he has already shook the foundations of Ameerkot twice before and can do it once again. The next day, Raj Mata changes her mind and for her well being, offers the kingdom near mount Abu to Avdesh. Avdesh declines Raj Mata's offer as he says that what she is offering him is just to small for the secret that he is asked to conceal. What would Avdesh demand Raj Mata for? Keep watching the engrossing episode of Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri meets Raj Mata and questions about her wound. Raj Mata tries to avoid off Gayatri saying she got hurt when she was doing some household work. Gayatri picks up and knife and tries to cut her palm, seeing this Raj Mata stops Gayatri and gets emotional. Avdesh begins to plan against Ranaji. It is also learnt that the woman who pretended to be Sulakshana developed a grudge against Indravadhan. What plan has Avdesh now crafted? Keep watching the engrossing episode of 'Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Raani' to find out.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of the Christmas Special the Year-End Special and the New-Year Special and the guest of the Year-End Special Episode is Kwon Jin ah. Kwon Jin ah is known for her tranquil and heartwarming voice that genuinely comforts our hearts. In February this year she released her first self-produced EP “The Way For Us” and showed off her capabilities as a songwriter and producer as well. In this episode Kwon Jin ah performs “KNOCK” “This Winter” and her solo version of “Hello Antenna Hello Christmas” the carol jointly released by musicians on the record label Antenna. Also famous for her live singing skills and ticket-selling power this artist is bound to melt our souls during this cold winter season. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.
